summary: Super League Enterprise filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amendment to increase the aggregate offering price under its at-the-market Sales Agreement with Benchmark (a StoneX company) and StoneX Financial from approximately $4.5 million to up to $5.465 million, adding $966,000 of common stock. Since August 18, 2026, 983,292 shares were sold for about $4.5 million gross. The Nasdaq-listed company cited a public float of roughly $16.4 million and eligibility under Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6; shares closed at $4.51 on September 28, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
